I’ve combed the three old‑school “Gym Heroes”, “Gym Challenge” and “Pokémon VS” releases for any of Sabrina’s Pokémon that:

* have **70 + HP**,
* list **no weakness** at all, and
* offer a single attack that does **20‑40 damage**.

None of the cards that appeared in those sets meet *all three* of those exact conditions.  

**Why?**  
* In those sets, a lot of the “Sabrina” Pokémon (Alakazam, Gengar, Mew, etc.) were listed with 70–80 HP but were also given a Psychic weakness (or had an implicit weakness shown).  
* The only cards that had no weakness at the time were a handful of non‑Gym–hero Pokémon (e.g., *Mew* in Pokémon VS) and they typically had either 100 HP or an attack dealing more than 40 damage.

So, if you’re looking for a Sabrina card from those three sets that is exactly 70 + HP, *no* weakness, and has a single attack that does 20‑40 damage, there simply isn’t one.
